subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start/model-routing semantics, while related users are asking for both cheaper/suppressed greetings and restored persona greetings; automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add explicit reset-start policy
options.body: Keep current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add one typed opt-in policy for startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

options.title: Restore startup turns by default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and explicitly accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Defer new reset controls
options.body: Keep current acknowledgement-only behavior and use `/new <message>` plus the narrower prompt-text tracker until a broader reset policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Add explicit reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Keep current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add one typed opt-in policy for startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current bare reset acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
